exports.name: Menubar
exports.description:
An application menu bar (File, Edit, View). Left/Right move between menus,
Down opens one, and an open menu follows the pointer across triggers. Rows
match DropdownMenu and ContextMenu.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
controlling animation with React animation libraries.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether keyboard navigation should loop around

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description:
Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
Can be prevented.

props.name: align
props.description:
Controls the direction the subcontent appears from its anchor menu item
Default: start
